text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Rudolf, do you remember? —That autumn.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
About our dream "Triple Crown Umamusume 
Showdown." When you and I faced off for 
the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"How could I ever forget? It wasn't just 
the Umamusume fans—the whole country was 
turned completely upside down."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so—I earned quite a lot of resentment. 
The fans looked upon the young, seemingly 
arrogant "Emperor" with cold gazes...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You were more popular too, C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Popularity, huh? Back then, why do you 
think I was the more popular one?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder... A difference in charm? Or 
perhaps humanity...?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it. Personally, I think it 
comes down to a difference in running 
styles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Running style?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You're a "Leader", and I'm a 
"Chaser".

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they just wanted to believe in a 
comeback. Because deep down, everyone 
thinks: "I'm just falling behind for now. 
I can turn it all around in the end."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you were running carrying that 
wish on your shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Back then, the expectations leaned 
toward me. But this autumn... is 
different.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. Both of them 
carry so many wishes upon their shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"The dream that 'you can succeed even if 
you're poor,' and the dream that 'you can 
succeed even from the regional 
circuit'..."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Two desires, burning equally strong. Those 
two will collide this autumn...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. The frenzy feels twice as 
intense as back then. This autumn will be 
their ultimate showdown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And what's more, this frenzy is probably—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hooooh, haaaah... Hooooh, haaaah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse. The venue's excitement 
was at its peak, with cheers echoing even 
indoors. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right now—I don't care. About anything. 
Nothing matters to me anymore...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna beat her. I wanna win, I 
wanna win, I wanna win.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —I'm gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross was completely focused. 
Nothing else entered her sight except the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The opponent's fighting spirit was 
unmistakable. It felt as if sheer aura 
were radiating from their body."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two stood still, gazing at one 
another. It felt almost like a ritual to 
sync their energy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —It's war, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day, Tokyo Racecourse— was about 
to burn pure white.
